issue_description: A container overflow read occurs in Photoshop::setIptcIrb() when iterating over IPTC IRB records. The code advances `pos` by the located record size and then passes `pPsData + pos` with `sizePsData - pos` to `locateIptcIrb()` without enforcing that `pos` remains within `sizePsData`, so a malformed IRB size can make the remaining length underflow and cause reads past the end of the Photoshop data buffer.
